```{r load packages and data}
if(!require(readr)){install.packages('readr')}
library(readr)
if(!require(tidyverse)){install.packages('tidyverse')}
library(tidyverse) 
if(!require(MOTE)){install.packages('MOTE')}
library(MOTE) 

df <- read_csv("Data/pbn_only/9.1.26.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
```

```{r clean data}
#Handle free-text responses in demographics

##Preset/valid levels
race_levels <- c("American Indian or Alaskan Native", "Asian (including Asian Desi)",
                 "Black/African American", "Hispanic/Latinx",
                 "Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander",
                 "White/Caucasian (includes Middle Eastern)", "Prefer not to answer")

gender_levels <- c("Cisgender man/boy", "Cisgender woman/girl", "Transgender man/boy",
                   "Transgender woman/girl", "Nonbinary", "Genderqueer", "Agender",
                   "Questioning", "Prefer not to answer")

orientation_levels <- c("Heterosexual/Straight", "Gay/Lesbian", "Bisexual", "Pansexual",
                        "Queer", "Asexual", "Questioning", "Prefer not the answer") #This typo is preserved from the survey

##Helpers
split_responses <- function(x) {
  parts <- str_split(x, "\\s*[;,]\\s*")[[1]]
  parts <- str_squish(parts)
  parts[parts != ""]
}

# Keeps preset selections in their original order; replaces all write-ins with a single "Other", keeping NA as a string
clean_multiselect <- function(x, levels) {
  if (is.na(x)) return("NA")
  parts <- split_responses(x)
  if (length(parts) == 0) return("NA")
  is_valid <- parts %in% levels
  out <- parts[is_valid]
  if (any(!is_valid)) out <- c(out, "Other")
  paste(unique(out), collapse = "; ")
}

# Returns only the write-in text
extract_othertext <- function(x, levels) {
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)
  parts <- split_responses(x)
  invalid <- parts[!parts %in% levels]
  if (length(invalid) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(invalid, collapse = "; ")
}

##Preserve original responses
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    dem_raceethnicity_raw = dem_raceethnicity,
    dem_genderidentity_raw = dem_genderidentity,
    dem_sexualorientation_raw = dem_sexualorientation
  )

##Create othertext columns and cleaned columns (othertext first, from the raw columns)
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    dem_raceethnicity_othertext = map_chr(dem_raceethnicity_raw, extract_othertext, race_levels),
    dem_genderidentity_othertext = map_chr(dem_genderidentity_raw, extract_othertext, gender_levels),
    dem_sexualorientation_othertext = map_chr(dem_sexualorientation_raw, extract_othertext, orientation_levels),

    dem_raceethnicity = map_chr(dem_raceethnicity_raw, clean_multiselect, race_levels),
    dem_genderidentity = map_chr(dem_genderidentity_raw, clean_multiselect, gender_levels),
    dem_sexualorientation = map_chr(dem_sexualorientation_raw, clean_multiselect, orientation_levels)
  )

#Separate out multiple select demographics data into multiple columns
make_dummies <- function(data, col) {
  data |>
    select(participant_id, all_of(col)) |>
    separate_rows(all_of(col), sep = ";\\s*") |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[col]])) |>   # avoids a "_NA" column
    mutate(value = 1) |>
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = participant_id,
      names_from = all_of(col),
      values_from = value,
      values_fill = list(value = 0),
      values_fn = list(value = max)
    ) |>
    rename_with(~ paste0(col, "_", .), -participant_id)
}

df <- df |>
  left_join(make_dummies(df, "dem_genderidentity"), by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(make_dummies(df, "dem_raceethnicity"), by = "participant_id")


#Factor categorical data
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(source, dem_raceethnicity, dem_genderidentity, dem_sexualorientation,
        dem_weightshapeconcern, dem_binge, dem_purge, dem_restrict,
        dem_foodinsecurity, dem_eddx, dem_currenttx),
      factor
    )
  )

#Make data numeric
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(contains("hopelessness"), contains("hopefulness"),
        contains("fas"), contains("bas"),
        rating_score),
      as.numeric
    )
  )
```

```{r subset sample}
df_sample_teen <- df |> 
  filter(source == "neda" | source == "study") |> 
  filter(
    str_detect(
      dem_age,
      regex("\\b(13|14|15|16|17)\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
  )
  
df_sample_teen_usa <- df_sample_teen %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      str_trim(dem_country),
      regex(
        "^(us|u\\.s\\.?|usa|u\\.s\\.a\\.?|america|americaaa|american|united states|the united states|united states of america|the united states of america|united stat|united state|unites states|u\\.s/va|north america|pennsylvania)$",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    )
  )

df_sample_teen_not_usa <- df_sample_teen %>%
  filter(
    !str_detect(
      str_trim(dem_country),
      regex(
        "^(us|u\\.s\\.?|usa|u\\.s\\.a\\.?|america|americaaa|american|united states|the united states|united states of america|the united states of america|united stat|united state|unites states|u\\.s/va|north america|pennsylvania)$",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r identify teen usa completers for EDRS abstract}
df_sample_teen_usa_fullcompleter <- df_sample_teen_usa |> #full completer according to Koko system (includes post-SSI demographics)
  filter(!is.na(completed_at))

df_sample_teen_usa_measurecompleter <- df_sample_teen_usa |> #considering a measure completer if proximal outcome change scores are present
   filter(!is.na(fas_change), !is.na(bas_change), !is.na(hopelessness_change))

df_sample_teen_usa_ssicompleter <- df_sample_teen_usa |> #the last selection option in the SSI is the best benchmark I have
  filter(!is.na(body_copingstatement))
```

```{r acceptability}
df_sample_teen_usa_measurecompleter |>
  summarize(
    mean = mean(rating_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(rating_score, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r pre post}

summary_stats_teen_usa <- df_sample_teen_usa_measurecompleter |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),

    hope_pre_mean  = mean(pre_hopefulness, na.rm = TRUE),
    hope_pre_sd    = sd(pre_hopefulness, na.rm = TRUE),
    hope_post_mean = mean(post_hopefulness, na.rm = TRUE),
    hope_post_sd   = sd(post_hopefulness, na.rm = TRUE),

    fas_pre_mean  = mean(pre_fas_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
    fas_pre_sd    = sd(pre_fas_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
    fas_post_mean = mean(post_fas_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
    fas_post_sd   = sd(post_fas_sum, na.rm = TRUE),

    bas_pre_mean  = mean(pre_bas_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
    bas_pre_sd    = sd(pre_bas_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
    bas_post_mean = mean(post_bas_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
    bas_post_sd   = sd(post_bas_sum, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

#Hopefulness
d_dep_t_avg(
  m1 = summary_stats_teen_usa$hope_post_mean, m2 = summary_stats_teen_usa$hope_pre_mean,
  sd1 = summary_stats_teen_usa$hope_post_sd,  sd2 = summary_stats_teen_usa$hope_pre_sd,
  n = summary_stats_teen_usa$n, a = .05
) |>  pluck("estimate")

#Functionality appreciation
d_dep_t_avg(
  m1 = summary_stats_teen_usa$fas_post_mean, m2 = summary_stats_teen_usa$fas_pre_mean,
  sd1 = summary_stats_teen_usa$fas_post_sd,  sd2 = summary_stats_teen_usa$fas_pre_sd,
  n = summary_stats_teen_usa$n, a = .05
) |>  pluck("estimate")

#Body appreciation
d_dep_t_avg(
  m1 = summary_stats_teen_usa$bas_post_mean, m2 = summary_stats_teen_usa$bas_pre_mean,
  sd1 = summary_stats_teen_usa$bas_post_sd,  sd2 = summary_stats_teen_usa$bas_pre_sd,
  n = summary_stats_teen_usa$n, a = .05
) |>  pluck("estimate")
```
